finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The function get_error_message might return user-controlled or attacker-controlled data, and printf does not sanitize the input before using it.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked for a path from untrusted data to the dangerous operation and found that the error_message is obtained from get_error_message, which is not shown in the provided code. There is no indication that get_error_message returns user-controlled or attacker-controlled data. Additionally, printf is used to print the error message, but there is no evidence of OS command injection. The code does not contain any command execution functions.
